model: page count + LRU residency lanes (int page, long tick, Control)
delta_ops: setPageCount(n) releases pages >= n only; showPage(i) materializes one page; releasePage(i)
damage: layout of the parent only (top control bounds); no page is created or laid out except the one shown
full_rebuild_paths: none: setPageCount never recreates resident pages
proof: M3StackLayoutTest, M3ResidentPagesTest, M3StackLayoutDifferentialTest (pixels and Show/Hide sequence vs StackLayout)
resize_sweep: BY DESIGN: a resize lays out the top control only (resident pages keep empty bounds); 50-size sweep pending

delta_ops: setValue(r,c,v) repaints its cell when on screen; update(fromRow,toRow) repaints the on-screen band of that row range; setOrigin scrolls (Control.scroll) and repaints the exposed strip
damage: cell or row band rectangle, clipped to the client area
whole_view_repaint_only_on: setSize, setPalette, setRange/autoRange widening (every cell colour changes)
full_rebuild_paths: none: no per-cell objects to rebuild
proof: M3HeatMapTest (cell repaint rectangles, band update, off-screen value change repaints nothing)
resize_sweep: OPEN: a resize repaints the whole client area (no NO_REDRAW_RESIZE yet); fix and sweep next

model: ints (frame, points, trail, delay, icon size) + point centre lanes xs/ys + trail shade array
delta_ops: setFrame / timer tick repaints the icon square only; setText repaints the text strip only; setTrailLength / setPointCount repaint the icon only
full_rebuild_paths: none: shades rebuilt only on colour, trail or point count change; a frame allocates nothing
proof: M3BusyLabelTest (frame paints inside the icon, text paints inside the strip, same frame or text repaints nothing, pixels after 5 frame deltas equal a direct paint)
resize_sweep: SWEEP WRITTEN (UI run pending): 50 widths, full repaints 0, paints only right of min(old, new) width; height change = 1 full repaint (re-centre)

model: slot lanes (mode, value, measured, x, width) + text lane + control lane
delta_ops: setText repaints its slot; a preferred slot that changes width repaints from itself on; setControl / updateSlot / removeSlot relayout from that slot; layout moves only controls whose slot changed
damage: slot rectangle, or the strip from the first changed edge to the end
whole_view_repaint_only_on: setFont (every measure changes), height change (every baseline moves)
full_rebuild_paths: none: content measured on change only, never on resize or layout
proof: M3StatusBarTest (tiling by prefix sums and cumulative rounding, slot-only repaints, growth repaints from the slot, controls follow, pixels after deltas equal a fresh bar)
resize_sweep: SWEEP WRITTEN (UI run pending): 2 bars x 50 widths, full repaints 0, paints only right of the first weighted slot (or the grip when none), a fixed-slot control never moves; height change = 1 full repaint

model: ints (extent, target, full width/height, steps, delay) + flags
delta_ops: setCollapsed measures the content once, then each frame changes the extent and slides the content (setLocation, no resize); a collapsed content is hidden (not laid out, not painted)
damage: none drawn (the pane has no paint); the parent re-lays out this pane only (layout(Control[]))
full_rebuild_paths: none: the content is measured once per state change, never per frame or resize
proof: M3CollapsiblePaneTest (measured once and laid out 0 times during an animation, collapsed content hidden, reversals finish once, horizontal axis)
resize_sweep: SWEEP WRITTEN (UI run pending): 50 widths expanded (content measured 0 times, width follows) and 50 widths collapsed (content laid out 0 times)
